---
title: Runtime formats without a veiled element
format:
  html: default
  revealjs: default
filters:
  - veil
revealjs-plugins:
  - veil
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: The filter adds nothing, and the plugin does not fail, when no element is veiled.
        check: "node veil-check.mjs"
    html:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ['veil-config', 'veil\.js']
    revealjs:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ['veil-config']
---

Plain content.
